topic: Among human randomized controlled trials, what treatment-emergent adverse effects are associated with omega-3 PUFA supplementation compared with placebo or standard treatment?

pico.population: Human participants enrolled in randomized controlled trials
pico.intervention_or_exposure: Supplemental long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids
pico.comparison: Placebo, control oil, or source-defined standard-treatment comparator
pico.outcome: Participants with at least one treatment-emergent diarrhea adverse event

eligible_study_designs: multiple independent randomized trials in one report

targets.outcome: Participants with at least one treatment-emergent diarrhea adverse event
targets.comparison: Omega-3 PUFA supplementation versus placebo or a source-defined randomized comparator

timepoint_policy.rule: Use the complete source-defined randomized adverse-event observation period. Preserve the reported duration and do not combine repeated windows.

targets.effect_selection_rule: Extract exact participant-level arm counts for each independent randomized comparison. Preserve exact but nonpoolable crossover, withdrawal-only, and overlapping-subgroup records so the downstream analysis task can reject them.
extraction_notes: Loose stools alone are not diarrhea unless the source maps them to the same outcome.
Composite gastrointestinal outcomes remain source-only findings.
No target-review forest values may be used to fill missing primary-source numbers.
source_constraints: do not infer unreported zero events
do not convert rounded percentages to exact counts
do not treat event episodes as participants
do not treat withdrawal due to diarrhea as any diarrhea
do not double count overlapping subgroups
do not split a shared control across separate effects
all component arms are randomized and mutually exclusive
the comparator is not counted more than once
the source reports participant-level rather than event-level counts
Keep independent trials in one paper separate.
For a factorial trial, collapse strata to one prespecified treatment main-effect comparison when all strata are mutually exclusive.
Do not pool a crossover record without paired event information.

primary_analysis_spec.outcome_group: Participants with at least one diarrhea adverse event
selection_rules: Select exact participant-level binary arm counts only.
Combine mutually exclusive eligible omega-3 dose arms before effect calculation when they share a comparator.
Keep independent trials separate, but collapse mutually exclusive factorial strata to one treatment main-effect comparison.
Exclude crossover records without paired event data, withdrawal-only outcomes, overlapping subgroup reports, composite outcomes, event-level records, rounded percentages, and narrative-only records.
Never count a participant or shared comparator twice.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
